title: Contract Duration, Renewal Notice and Early Exit Charges by Programme Tier
content:
One contract term of a Corporate Travel Programme runs for the number of calendar months published for the tier held. Every tier of the Corporate Travel Programmes renews automatically at the end of its term. Notice not to renew is due the published number of calendar days before the term ends, and ending the contract before the term expires carries the charge published for the tier.

| Programme tier | Contract term | Renews automatically | Notice not to renew | Charge for ending the contract early |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Business Starter Programme | 1 calendar months | Yes | 0 calendar days before the term ends | 0.00 USD |
| Business Team Programme | 12 calendar months | Yes | 30 calendar days before the term ends | 750.00 USD |
| Business Pro Programme | 12 calendar months | Yes | 30 calendar days before the term ends | 2250.00 USD |
| Business Enterprise Programme | 24 calendar months | Yes | 60 calendar days before the term ends | 7500.00 USD |
| Business Enterprise Plus Programme | 24 calendar months | Yes | 90 calendar days before the term ends | 18000.00 USD |
| Business Global Programme | 36 calendar months | Yes | 120 calendar days before the term ends | 39000.00 USD |

## Reading the schedule

- **Term.** The shortest published term is the one calendar month of the Business Starter Programme; the longest is the 36 calendar months of the Business Global Programme. The Business Team Programme and the Business Pro Programme each run 12 calendar months, and the Business Enterprise Programme and the Business Enterprise Plus Programme each run 24.
- **Notice.** The Business Starter Programme carries a notice period of 0 calendar days. The notice period lengthens with the tier: 30 calendar days on the Business Team Programme and the Business Pro Programme, 60 on the Business Enterprise Programme, 90 on the Business Enterprise Plus Programme and 120 on the Business Global Programme.
- **Early exit.** No charge is published for the Business Starter Programme, whose early exit figure stands at 0.00 USD. The published charge is 750.00 USD on the Business Team Programme, 2250.00 USD on the Business Pro Programme, 7500.00 USD on the Business Enterprise Programme, 18000.00 USD on the Business Enterprise Plus Programme and 39000.00 USD on the Business Global Programme.
